text:
Mira: heads-up  proposing a small-scope roadmap item: automatic fallback lanes for Dedicated when microburst headroom is exhausted. aim: keep latency bounded while preserving billing predictability. thoughts?

Alex: agree it's needed. Q: fallback -> cheaper model variant, regional spillover, or queueing?

Mira: prefer ordered fallbacks: 1) warm fallback model variant (lower perf, cheaper), 2) regional spillover if latency budget allows, 3) soft-throttle with informative 429 + retry-after. avoid silent overage.

Sanjeev: important to define billing semantics: if fallback model used, do we bill at original SKU or fallback SKU? ops prefers billing at fallback SKU to be fair to customers. billing-bot: confirm implications.

billing-bot: recommended rule: fallback-model usage billed at fallback SKU rate; spillover counts as normal consumption in target region (may hit different committed pools); soft-throttle not billed. need sample invoice lines for legal.

Rachel: launch criteria suggestions:
- end-to-end p95 with fallback engaged < 500ms for 95% synthetic microbursts
- fallbacks triggered < 2% of requests in steady-state customer traffic
- billing doc + sample invoices live
- console shows per-tenant fallback events + reason codes

Alex: safety rules: auto-disable fallback if p99 rises > 30% vs baseline for 15m, and cap fallback switchbacks to 6/hour per-region to avoid flapping. also require metric names in PRD (route.p95_1m, fallback.switch_count_5m).

Mira: prioritization: alpha (2 weeks): implement fallback decision path + reason codes, console event stream, billing mapping. Beta (6 weeks): region spillover orchestration, graceful retry middleware, self-serve fallback opt-outs.

Sanjeev: eng asks: 1 BE to implement decision path, 1 infra to wire metrics & rollback hooks, 1 SRE for canary run. Ops will generate synthetic microbursts (short spikes + long tails).

Mira: thanks all  I'll draft a concise PRD with the acceptance criteria above and open GH epic fallback-lanes/alpha. tagging @alex @sanjeev @rachel for review before PRD lands.

billing-bot: reminder: billing sample template -> https://redwood.internal/billing/templates/fallback-sample (internal)

Mira: scheduling a 20m huddle tomorrow to finalize wording. :thumbsup:
